title: Series circuit
notes: A D cell (+ and − marked), a closed switch and a glowing bulb in its holder, joined by wires in one closed loop. Drawn from general knowledge.

title: Magnets
notes: A bar magnet (N red, S blue) with paper clips and iron filings at its ends, and a horseshoe magnet (N red, S blue tips) holding paper clips. Drawn from general knowledge.

title: Ball rolling down a ramp
notes: A long wooden ramp propped on a stack of 3 blocks, a ball partway down it with motion lines, and a dashed path with an arrow running on across a gray floor to the right edge. Drawn from general knowledge.

title: Water waves
notes: Side view of even water waves (every crest the same height and the same distance apart, 4 crests and 3 troughs) over a dashed still-water line, with a small sailboat bobbing in the middle trough; no words, so crest, trough, wavelength and amplitude can be pointed out. Drawn from general knowledge.
